headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Revenue after deducting excise increased 3.9% to INR 20,269 cr.
Consolidated profit before exceptional items and tax declined 17% to INR 5,720 cr, while total PAT fell 18.5% to INR 4,229 cr.
Strong non-cigarette growth partly offset pressure on cigarette profitability.

Management focused on new variants, portfolio interventions and protecting its consumer franchise against illicit trade.  FMCG–Others: Revenue increased 19.1% YoY to INR 7,218 cr, while segment profit rose 31.4% to INR 577 cr.
watch: Operational performance across key business segments was as follows, with financial figures on a consolidated basis:  Cigarettes: Segment profit declined 26% YoY to INR 4,044 cr, although performance improved sequentially.
Outlook and Strategy for FY27: Management prioritised protecting the cigarette consumer franchise through calibrated portfolio actions and new variants amid higher taxes and illicit-trade risks.
